subcategories.name: Veterinary Semen Analysis Solutions

products.name: SQA-Vision
products.short_description: Automated semen analysis with a 75-second test cycle across routine, fertility-preparation and specialist sample types.
products.description: The SQA-Vision provides fully automated measurement of core semen parameters and supports semi-automated advanced assessments. MES positions the system for objective, standardised testing in andrology laboratories, with visualisation, WHO 6th Edition-compatible software and LIS/EMR connectivity.
specifications: Fresh, IUI/IVF, washed, post-vasectomy, frozen, mail-in, longevity and manual count
Sperm concentration; motility; rapid, slow and non-progressive motility; normal morphology; functional sperm; velocity; and additional parameters
DNA fragmentation (WHO 6th classifications), vitality, full differential morphology, debris/round cells, pH and WBC
FDA cleared; CLIA moderately complex; CAP/API proficiency; regulatory compliance in more than 50 countries

products.name: SQA-iO | CLIA Waived
products.short_description: A compact, web-based, FDA-cleared and CLIA-waived analyzer delivering WHO 6th Edition semen-analysis results in under 75 seconds.
products.description: The SQA-iOw combines a web-based interface and compact format for diagnostic semen testing and sample-preparation quality control. It reports concentration, motility, morphology and additional parameters, and can integrate with the SQA-VU visualisation system and laboratory information systems.
specifications: Sperm concentration, motility, morphology and additional parameters
Integrates with the SQA-VU visualisation system

products.name: SQA-V Gold
products.short_description: Automated sperm count, morphology, motility and 13 additional parameters with integrated visualisation and LIS transfer.
products.description: The SQA-V Gold is an automated semen analyzer for fresh, washed, frozen and post-vasectomy samples. It requires no sample dilution, supports two sample-volume options and combines automated analysis with a 500× visualisation system.
specifications: Sperm count, morphology, motility and 13 additional parameters
Included on the CAP proficiency schedule
Not available in America or Canada

products.name: QwikCheck Gold
products.short_description: Discontinued MES automated analyzer for sperm count, morphology, motility and 13 additional parameters.
products.description: QwikCheck Gold is a discontinued MES automated semen analyzer. The legacy system reports sperm count, morphology, motility and 13 additional parameters for fresh, washed, frozen and post-vasectomy samples, with archive software for result management.
specifications: Sperm count, morphology, motility and 13 additional parameters
Runs latex beads and is included on the CAP proficiency schedule
Not available in America or Canada

products.name: QwikCheck Test Kits
products.short_description: Problem-solving QwikCheck kits for manual and automated semen analysis, sample preparation and quality control.
products.description: The official QwikCheck Test Kits family groups MES quality-control, dilution, liquefaction, vitality, test-strip quality-control, fixed-coverslip and WBC/pH reagent products.

products.name: Advanced Testing Kits
products.short_description: MES advanced semen-testing kits for specialised laboratory assessment.
products.description: The official Advanced Testing Kits family contains the QwikCheck DFI Kit for DNA Fragmentation Index testing using the Sperm Chromatin Dispersion method.

products.name: QwikCheck Validation Kits
products.short_description: QwikCheck kits for initial and semi-annual validation of SQA systems.
products.description: The official QwikCheck Validation Kits family groups MES proficiency, training, precision and linearity products for validating SQA analyzers.

products.name: QwikCheck & SQA Supplies
products.short_description: Official QwikCheck and SQA capillaries, reagent strips and morphology supplies.
products.description: The official QwikCheck & SQA Supplies family groups low-volume and standard testing capillaries, fixed-coverslip slides, WBC/pH reagent strips and morphology slides.

products.name: QwikCheck™ Quality Control Beads
products.short_description: Three-level in-vitro quality-control material for assessing accuracy and precision in automated and manual sperm counting.
products.description: QwikCheck Quality Control Beads provide known target values for laboratory sperm-counting quality control. MES identifies them for QwikCheck Gold, Spermalite, SQA-V Gold and SQA-Vision analyzers as well as manual counting chambers.
specifications: In-vitro quality control for automated and manual sperm counting systems
QwikCheck Gold, Spermalite, SQA-V Gold and SQA-Vision

products.name: QwikCheck™ Dilution Kit
products.short_description: Earl’s Balanced Salt solution for diluting semen before automated or manual testing.
products.description: The QwikCheck Dilution Kit supports sperm motility and vitality during dilution. MES states that it can increase sample volume for fully automated low-volume testing on SQA sperm quality analyzers and is recommended by the WHO Manual.
specifications: Semen dilution before automated or manual testing
Increasing sample volume for fully automated low-volume testing

products.name: QwikCheck™ Liquefaction Kit
products.short_description: Sample-preparation kit for promoting and accelerating liquefaction of highly viscous semen samples.
products.description: The QwikCheck Liquefaction Kit prepares highly viscous samples for automated or manual semen analysis. MES also identifies use with agglutinated or aggregated samples and other conditions that prevent thorough mixing before analysis.
specifications: Promotes and accelerates liquefaction of highly viscous semen samples

products.name: QwikCheck™ 1-Step Vitality Stain
products.short_description: One-step stain for grading live and dead sperm to supplement manual or automated motility results.
products.description: The QwikCheck 1-Step Vitality Stain differentiates live from dead sperm cells. The kit contains five premixed vials and can be used with manual methods or the SQA-Vision Touch-to-Mark interface.
specifications: Manual methods and SQA-Vision Touch-to-Mark interface

products.name: QwikCheck™ WBC/pH Test Strips Quality Control
products.short_description: Professional in-vitro quality control for QwikCheck semen pH and leukocyte test strips.
products.description: QwikCheck Test Strip Quality Control validates the pH and WBC patches on QwikCheck Test Strips. Results are read by comparing the developed strip colours with the supplied colour chart.
specifications: Validation of QwikCheck WBC/pH Test Strips

products.name: QwikCheck™ Fixed Coverslip Slides
products.short_description: Dual-chamber fixed-coverslip slides for routine manual and automated semen screening.
products.description: QwikCheck Fixed Coverslip Slides use a precision fluid chamber to distribute sperm or quality-control material into one field of view. They load by capillary action and provide two chambers for duplicate counts.

products.name: QwikCheck™ WBC/pH Test Reagent Strips
products.short_description: FDA-cleared professional test strips for determining pH and leukocytes in semen.
products.description: QwikCheck WBC/pH Test Reagent Strips determine semen pH and leukocyte levels by colour comparison with the chart on the bottle. MES identifies them as the only FDA-cleared test strip designed specifically for semen.

products.name: QwikCheck™ DFI Kit DNA Fragmentation
products.short_description: In-vitro diagnostic kit for sperm DNA Fragmentation Index assessment using the SCD method.
products.description: The QwikCheck DFI Kit prepares slides for DNA Fragmentation Index assessment using the Sperm Chromatin Dispersion method and WHO 6th Edition five-category methodology. Evaluation can be performed with a microscope or the SQA-Vision analyzer.
specifications: Microscope or SQA-Vision Automated Sperm Quality Analyzer

products.name: QwikCheck Beads™ Proficiency and Training Kit
products.short_description: Initial proficiency, training and validation kit for bringing SQA instruments online.
products.description: The QwikCheck Beads Proficiency and Training Kit supports initial accuracy, linearity, precision and lower-limit-detection studies for SQA-V and SQA-Vision analyzers. MES also includes protocols for backup-method comparison and data analysis.
specifications: Accuracy, linearity, precision and lower limit detection

products.name: QwikCheck™ Beads Precision and Linearity Kit
products.short_description: Semi-annual SQA system mini-validation kit for precision, detection limit, accuracy and linearity.
products.description: The QwikCheck Beads Precision and Linearity Kit is MES’s recommended semi-annual validation tool for SQA-V and SQA-Vision analyzers. It supports linearity, repeatability, lower-limit-detection and concentration-accuracy checks.
specifications: Repeatability, lower limit detection, accuracy and linearity

products.name: SQA - Low Volume Testing Capillary
products.short_description: Low-volume SQA capillary for automated testing of washed, frozen and fertility-preparation samples.
products.description: The SQA Low Volume Testing Capillary is designed for washed, frozen and other IUI/IVF fertility preparations. MES specifies a 10-microlitre sample for assessing motile and progressive counts, total counts, velocity and additional parameters.
specifications: Washed, frozen and other IUI/IVF fertility preparations
Motile and progressive motile sperm counts, total motile and progressive counts, velocity and additional parameters

products.name: SQA - Testing Capillary
products.short_description: Standard SQA testing capillary for fresh, washed, frozen and other fertility samples.
products.description: The standard SQA Testing Capillary supports concentration, motility, morphology, motile and progressive sperm counts, total counts, velocity and additional assessments across fresh and prepared samples.
specifications: Fresh, washed, frozen and other fertility preparations
Concentration, motility, normal morphology, motile and progressive counts, total counts, velocity and additional parameters

products.name: QwikCheck™ 1-Step Morphology Slides
products.short_description: Pre-coated rapid-staining slides for detailed morphology assessment with SQA-Vision or microscopy.
products.description: QwikCheck 1-Step Morphology Slides use a dried staining layer for rapid sperm morphology assessment. MES designed them for SQA-Vision analyzers and microscopy to differentiate normal cells and classify defects, WBCs and pinheads.
specifications: Rapid staining for detailed sperm morphology assessment
SQA-Vision Automated Sperm Quality Analyzer and microscopy
Normal and abnormal sperm morphology, WBCs and pinheads

products.name: Bi-Directional LIS/EMR Interface
products.short_description: MES interface for exchanging patient demographics and semen-analysis results between the SQA-Vision and laboratory systems.
products.description: The MES Bi-Directional LIS/EMR Interface connects the SQA-Vision with leading laboratory and electronic medical record systems. It receives patient demographics, supports barcode-driven sample identification and transmits completed semen-analysis results back to the connected system.
specifications: Patient demographics and completed test results

products.name: SQA-VU Visualization System
products.short_description: Visualization system supplied with the SQA-iO for viewing samples and capturing semen-analysis images and video.
products.description: The SQA-VU Visualization System is an official component of the SQA-iO system. MES describes it as providing live sample viewing plus image and video capture through the SQA-iO application.
specifications: Live viewing, image capture and video capture

products.name: Docking Station for SQA-iOw + VU
products.short_description: Official docking station included with the SQA-iO and SQA-VU visualization system.
products.description: MES lists the Docking Station for SQA-iOw + VU among the components included with its complete SQA-iO automated semen-analysis system.
specifications: SQA-iOw analyzer and SQA-VU visualization system

products.name: Desktop PC + Monitor
products.short_description: Computer and monitor package included with the SQA-iO system in the United States and Canada.
products.description: MES lists a Desktop PC + Monitor as part of the complete SQA-iO system supplied in the United States and Canada.

products.name: SQA Semen Analysis Test Kit
products.short_description: Official semen-analysis test kit included with the SQA-iO automated analyzer system.
products.description: MES includes the SQA Semen Analysis Test Kit with the SQA-iO system for its semen-analysis workflow.

products.name: SQA QC & Cleaning Kit
products.short_description: Quality-control and cleaning kit included with the SQA-iO automated analyzer system.
products.description: MES includes the SQA QC & Cleaning Kit with the SQA-iO system to support quality control and analyzer maintenance.

products.name: MaleMan Reference Lab Services
products.short_description: MES reference-laboratory semen-testing service with at-home collection and provider-facing results.
products.description: MaleMan is the MES reference-laboratory service for healthcare providers. MES supplies at-home specimen-collection kits, performs testing in its CLIA-certified and CAP-accredited laboratory using the SQA-Vision, and supports white-label and private-label programs.

products.name: YO Home Sperm Test Kit
products.short_description: At-home, smartphone-based sperm test reporting five semen parameters and a live sample video.
products.description: The YO Home Sperm Test Kit is an over-the-counter, smartphone-based semen-analysis product. MES states that it reports five sperm parameters, displays a live sample video and includes supplies for three tests without requiring the sample to be shipped to a laboratory.
specifications: Five sperm parameters and live sample video

products.name: YO Testing Device
products.short_description: Smartphone-connected testing device supplied in the YO Home Sperm Test Kit.
products.description: MES lists the YO Testing Device as the reusable device included in the YO Home Sperm Test Kit. It works with a compatible smartphone and the YO application to analyze the prepared sample.

products.name: YO 3 Test Refill Kit
products.short_description: Official three-test refill kit for the reusable YO Home Sperm Test device.
products.description: MES identifies the YO 3 Test Refill Kit as the refill option available for customers who already have the reusable YO testing device.

products.name: SQA-Vb - Bovine Semen Quality Analyzer
products.short_description: Automated bovine semen analyzer delivering quantitative bull-semen evaluation in less than one minute.
products.description: The SQA-Vb is MES's automated system for quantitative bull-semen evaluation. It provides results in less than one minute and is supplied with a computer and B-Sperm data-management software for breeding-program workflows.

products.name: B-Sperm Data Management Software
products.short_description: Bovine semen-analysis data-management software supplied with the SQA-Vb.
products.description: MES supplies B-Sperm Data Management Software with the SQA-Vb bovine semen quality analyzer to support bull-semen analysis records and breeding-program workflows.

products.name: SQA-Vp - Porcine Semen Quality Analyzer
products.short_description: Automated porcine semen analyzer delivering quantitative boar-semen evaluation in less than one minute.
products.description: The SQA-Vp is MES's automated system for quantitative boar-semen evaluation. It provides results in less than one minute and uses a preheated testing capillary with temperature control. MES supplies the system with a computer and P-Sperm software.
specifications: Preheated testing capillary and temperature control

products.name: P-Sperm Data Management Software
products.short_description: Porcine semen-analysis data-management software supplied with the SQA-Vp.
products.description: MES supplies P-Sperm Data Management Software with the SQA-Vp porcine semen quality analyzer for boar-semen analysis data and breeding-program workflows.

products.name: SQA-Ve - Equine Semen Quality Analyzer
products.short_description: Automated equine semen analyzer for raw, extended and cooled stallion samples with results in about two minutes.
products.description: The SQA-Ve is MES's automated system for raw, extended and cooled stallion-semen samples. It provides quantitative analysis in approximately two minutes and is supplied with a computer and E-Sperm data-management software.
specifications: Not available in the United States

products.name: E-Sperm Data Management Software
products.short_description: Equine semen-analysis data-management software supplied with the SQA-Ve.
products.description: MES supplies E-Sperm Data Management Software with the SQA-Ve equine semen quality analyzer for stallion-semen analysis data and breeding-program workflows.

products.name: SQA-Vt - Avian Semen Quality Analyzer
products.short_description: Automated avian semen analyzer delivering quantitative turkey-semen evaluation in less than one minute.
products.description: The SQA-Vt is MES's automated system for quantitative turkey-semen evaluation. It provides results in less than one minute and is supplied with a computer and T-Sperm flock-management software.

products.name: T-Sperm Flock Management Software
products.short_description: Avian flock-management software supplied with the SQA-Vt semen quality analyzer.
products.description: MES supplies T-Sperm Flock Management Software with the SQA-Vt. MES identifies archive, quality-control, video and sorting functions for managing turkey-semen and flock records.
specifications: Archive, quality control, video and sorting

items.name: SQA-iOw Automated Analyzer
items.description: The FDA-cleared, CLIA-waived SQA-iOw delivers precise WHO 6th Edition results for sperm concentration, motility, morphology, and much more in under 75 seconds. Built for compliance and ease of use, it is backed by 25 years of global experience and customer support.

items.name: SQA-VU Visualization System
items.description: The SQA-Vu is a visual interface that integrates with the SQA-iOw App, allowing users to view samples in real time and easily capture images and record videos.

items.name: Docking Station for SQA-iOw + VU
items.description: The SQA Docking Station offers a streamlined, space-saving solution for securely integrating the SQA-iOw and SQA-VU, ensuring reliable connectivity and an organized workspace for efficient diagnostic testing.

items.name: Desktop PC + Monitor
items.description: The Desktop PC & Monitor is a user-friendly computer designed to work directly with the SQA-iOw Semen Analyzer. Featuring an intuitive interface, it simplifies data entry, results visualization, and system operation. Only included in USA & Canada markets.

items.name: SQA Semen Analysis Test Kit
items.description: The SQA Semen Analysis Test Kit delivers essential consumables for routine semen analysis, WBC/pH screening, and sample liquefaction, supporting efficient workflows and standardized testing when used with SQA analyzers.

items.name: SQA QC & Cleaning Kit
items.description: The QC & Cleaning Kit is perfect for the SQA-iOw, supporting routine quality control testing and device maintenance in laboratory settings. It helps verify system performance using standardized QC materials while supporting ongoing quality assurance practices.

items.name: QwikCheck Fixed Coverslip Slides
items.description: QwikCheck Fixed Coverslip Slides are designed for sample visualization, featuring a dual-chamber design that evenly distributes ~4 µL samples for clear, consistent viewing.

items.name: QwikCheck Proficiency & Training Kit
items.description: The QwikCheck Proficiency & Training Kit supports CLIA-compliant validation of new SQA analyzers, including accuracy, precision, and linearity, with complimentary data analysis and training support.
